continuity.opening: Pinocchio starts towards school with Geppetto's sacrificed coat transformed into a primer.
continuity.closing: After saving Harlequin, Pinocchio stands before Fire Eater as coins ring inside the theatre owner's purse.
continuity.next: A generous gift meant for Geppetto will attract two polished strangers on the road home.

learningObjective: Narrate temptation, danger, and moral courage with persuasive contrast, escalating action, and purposeful dialogue.

beats.title: School or Music
beats.purpose: Establish sincere plans and the first small turn away from them.

beats.title: The Price of a Ticket
beats.purpose: Make the primer sale feel like a conscious exchange of sacrifice for pleasure.

beats.title: A Family of Puppets
beats.purpose: Give Pinocchio an intoxicating welcome before authority enters.

beats.title: Fire Eater's Threat
beats.purpose: Shift the theatre from joy to a credible but child-safe danger.

beats.title: Danger Moves to Harlequin
beats.purpose: Show that being spared is not the same as solving the moral problem.

beats.title: Burn Me Instead
beats.purpose: Let Pinocchio act courageously despite visible fear.

beats.title: A Feast, Not a Fire
beats.purpose: Release the tension and let honest speech follow brave action.

beats.title: One More Surprise
beats.purpose: Acknowledge the lost primer and carry hope towards the next chapter.
